mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.password, u.username, u.login_type, u.provider_id, u.birthdate, u.user_profile_url, u.is_deleted, u.growth_score, u.created_at, u.updated_at, r.role FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id = ur.FK1 LEFT JOIN roles r ON ur.FK2 = r.role_id WHERE u.email = #{email}

SELECT u.user_id, u.email, u.password, u.username, u.login_type, u.provider_id, u.birthdate, u.user_profile_url, u.is_deleted, u.growth_score, u.created_at, u.updated_at, r.role FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id = ur.FK1 LEFT JOIN roles r ON ur.FK2 = r.role_id WHERE u.email = #{email} AND u.login_type = #{loginType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password, username, login_type, provider_id, birthdate, user_profile_url) VALUES (#{email}, #{password}, #{username}, #{loginType}, #{providerId}, #{birthdate}, #{userProfileUrl})
INSERT INTO user_roles (FK1, FK2) VALUES (#{userId}, (SELECT role_id FROM roles WHERE role = #{role}))
